description: Publishes one pending listing immediately by its visible pending listing id. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

pendingListingId.description: Visible pending listing id, only for pending listings where HGRWeb shows this id.

productId.description: Visible marketplace Product Id / primary id. Prefer this for active or terminated listings.

name: hgr_list_pending_now
title: List Pending Now
